title: Other ways of talking about the future
summary: Конструкции **be due to, be set to, be bound to, be likely/unlikely to, be on the verge of, have yet to, stand to** и другие способы говорить о будущем, помимо will и going to.
ru:
## Зачем нужны другие конструкции
Will, going to и Present continuous выражают прогноз и намерение в общем виде. Но в новостях, отчётах и грамотной устной речи будущее чаще передают точнее: ожидаемое по расписанию, почти неизбежное, маловероятное, готовое вот-вот случиться. Каждая конструкция добавляет свой оттенок.

## Расписание и ожидание: be due to, be scheduled to, be expected to
**be due to + инфинитив** — событие ожидается в определённое время по расписанию или графику:
> The train **is due to** arrive at 6.15. — Поезд должен прибыть в 6.15.
> The baby **is due** in May. — Роды ожидаются в мае.
**be scheduled to / be expected to** — то же, но **scheduled** подчёркивает график, а **expected** — что так считают другие:
> The vote **is scheduled to** take place on Thursday. — Голосование назначено на четверг.
> Prices **are expected to** fall. — Ожидается снижение цен.

## Уверенность и вероятность
- **be bound to / be certain to / be sure to** — почти неизбежно, говорящий уверен:
> You **are bound to** like her. — Она тебе непременно понравится.
- **be likely to / be unlikely to** — вероятно / маловероятно (вероятность оценивается, а не гарантируется):
> The talks **are unlikely to** succeed. — Переговоры вряд ли увенчаются успехом.
- **Be sure to + инфинитив** в повелительном наклонении — «обязательно сделай»:
> **Be sure to** back up your files. — Обязательно сделайте резервную копию файлов.
- С оборотом **there**: **There is bound to be / likely to be** a delay.

## Журналистский стиль: be set to, be poised to
**be set to / be poised to** — «готов(о) к», «вот-вот»; обычно в заголовках и репортажах:
> The airline **is set to** cut 500 jobs. — Авиакомпания намерена сократить 500 рабочих мест.
> The champion **is poised to** retire. — Чемпион готов завершить карьеру.

## На грани: be on the verge/point of + -ing
После предлога **of** — только герундий (не инфинитив!):
> The company **is on the verge of going** bankrupt. — Компания на грани банкротства.
> She **was on the point of resigning**. — Она уже собиралась уйти в отставку.

## Ещё полезные модели
- **have yet to + инфинитив** — «ещё не сделал (но должен будет)»: The ministry **has yet to** respond. — Министерство пока не ответило.
- **stand to lose / gain** — «рискует потерять / может выиграть»: Investors **stand to lose** millions.
- **hope / expect / plan / intend + to**: We're **hoping to** finish by Friday.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~He is on the verge to cry.~~ → He is on the verge **of crying**.
- ~~The train is about to arrive at 6.15.~~ → The train **is due to arrive** at 6.15.
- ~~We have yet received no reply.~~ → We **have yet to receive** a reply.
- ~~He is bound winning.~~ → He **is bound to win**.
en:
## Why we need more than will and going to
Will, going to and the present continuous give a general prediction or intention. In the news, in reports and in careful speech we often want to be more exact: something expected by timetable, almost certain, unlikely, or about to happen. Each structure adds its own shade of meaning.

## Timetable and expectation: be due to, be scheduled to, be expected to
**be due to + infinitive** — expected at a particular time according to a schedule:
> The train **is due to** arrive at 6.15.
> The baby **is due** in May.
**be scheduled to / be expected to**:
> The vote **is scheduled to** take place on Thursday.
> Prices **are expected to** fall.

## Certainty and probability
- **be bound to / be certain to / be sure to** — almost inevitable, the speaker is confident:
> You **are bound to** like her.
- **be likely to / be unlikely to** — probable / improbable:
> The talks **are unlikely to** succeed.
- **Be sure to + infinitive** as an order: **Be sure to** back up your files.
- With *there*: **There is bound to be / likely to be** a delay.

## News style: be set to, be poised to
> The airline **is set to** cut 500 jobs.
> The champion **is poised to** retire.

## On the edge: be on the verge/point of + -ing
After the preposition **of** we use an -ing form, never an infinitive:
> The company **is on the verge of going** bankrupt.
> She **was on the point of resigning**.

## More useful patterns
- **have yet to + infinitive** — has not done it yet: The ministry **has yet to** respond.
- **stand to lose / gain** — is likely to lose / gain: Investors **stand to lose** millions.
- **hope / expect / plan / intend + to**: We're **hoping to** finish by Friday.

## Common mistakes
- ~~He is on the verge to cry.~~ → He is on the verge **of crying**.
- ~~The train is about to arrive at 6.15.~~ → The train **is due to arrive** at 6.15.
- ~~We have yet received no reply.~~ → We **have yet to receive** a reply.
structure:
## Формулы
| Конструкция | Построение | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| по расписанию | be **due to** + V | The flight is **due to** land at 9. |
| по графику | be **scheduled to** + V | The vote is **scheduled to** start at 10. |
| ожидается | be **expected to** + V | Sales are **expected to** rise. |
| неизбежность | be **bound / certain / sure to** + V | He is **bound to** notice. |
| вероятность | be **likely / unlikely to** + V | It is **unlikely to** work. |
| новости | be **set / poised to** + V | The bank is **set to** merge. |
| на грани | be **on the verge / point of** + V-ing | She is **on the verge of** crying. |
| ещё нет | **have yet to** + V | He **has yet to** reply. |
| рискует / может выиграть | **stand to** + lose / gain | We **stand to** lose a lot. |

## Сравнение по смыслу
| Форма | Оттенок | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| is **bound to** | уверен(а): неизбежно | She is bound to win. |
| is **likely to** | вероятно, но не наверняка | She is likely to win. |
| is **unlikely to** | вряд ли | She is unlikely to win. |
| is **due to** | по расписанию | The result is due to be published. |

## Отрицание
> The talks **are not likely to** succeed. = The talks **are unlikely to** succeed.
> The firm **is not due to** report until June.
> **Isn't** he **bound to** be upset? — Разве он не расстроится?

exercises.title: Подберите слово
exercises.instruction: Вставьте одно слово: due, bound, set, sure, to, verge, unlikely и т. п. Допустимые синонимы засчитываются.

items.text: The 7.45 to Leeds is {{due|scheduled|expected}} to arrive at platform 4 shortly.
With so much traffic, we are {{bound|sure|certain|going}} to be late.
The company is on the {{verge|brink|point}} of collapsing.
She is {{unlikely|not likely}} to change her mind after so many years.
The firm has yet {{to}} publish its accounts for last year.
Be {{sure|certain}} to lock the door when you leave.
Investors in the failed scheme stand {{to}} lose most of their savings.

exercises.title: to, of или -ing?
exercises.instruction: Вставьте **to**, **of** или форму на **-ing** (глагол в скобках дан в подсказке).

items.text: The old bridge is on the point of {{collapsing}}.
We are hoping {{to}} finish the report by Friday.
Our new product is set {{to}} launch in March.
The company is poised {{to}} announce record profits.
He was on the verge {{of}} resigning when the offer arrived.
There is bound {{to}} be a queue at the border on a Friday evening.
The minister has yet {{to}} comment on the report.

exercises.title: Выберите конструкцию
exercises.instruction: Выберите вариант, подходящий по смыслу и грамматике.

items.q: Don't worry about the interview — with your experience, you ___ get the job.
The company is on the verge of ___ its biggest rival.
The government ___ to publish the report, although it promised to do so last month.
items.why: **have yet to + инфинитив** — «ещё не сделало» (в том же значении встречается и **is yet to**). **has already** и **has not yet** с **to + инфинитив** не сочетаются.

items.q: Residents ___ to lose their homes if the dam is built.
___ to switch off the lights before you go.
Prices ___ to climb further, analysts warn.
items.why: В новостном стиле — **are set to + инфинитив**.

items.q: Какое предложение выражает почти полную уверенность?
options: He is bound to find out.
He is likely to find out.
He is unlikely to find out.
The conference is due to start at nine.
The conference is bound to start at nine.
The conference stands to start at nine.
She's on the verge of crying.
She's on the verge to cry.
She's on the point of crying.
items.why: После **verge of / point of** нужен герундий, а не инфинитив.

items.q: Какой вариант типичен для газетного заголовка?
items.why: **set to** + инфинитив; be в заголовке опущено.

items.q: 'Fans stand to lose their tickets.' означает:
options: Болельщики стоят в очереди за билетами.

exercises.title: Перефразируйте
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, используя слово в скобках. Начало дано.

items.prompt: It is certain that the weather will be awful (bound). → The weather ...
answers: The weather is bound to be awful.
The weather's bound to be awful.

items.prompt: It is unlikely that she will win. → She ...
answers: She is not likely to win.

items.prompt: According to the timetable, the plane will land at 11.30 (due). → The plane ...
answers: The plane is due to land at 11.30.
The plane's due to land at 11.30.
The plane is due to land at 11:30.
The plane's due to land at 11:30.

items.prompt: The bank is very close to going bankrupt (verge + -ing). → The bank ...
answers: The bank is on the verge of going bankrupt.
The bank's on the verge of going bankrupt.

items.prompt: We haven't received a reply yet (have yet). → We ...
answers: We have yet to receive a reply.
We've yet to receive a reply.

items.prompt: The company will probably cut 500 jobs, newspapers report (set). → The company ...
answers: The company is set to cut 500 jobs.
The company's set to cut 500 jobs.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями, используя конструкции юнита.

items.prompt: What are you bound to do this week?
items.sample: I'm bound to be busy this week because of the deadline.

items.prompt: What is likely or unlikely to happen in your city next year?
items.sample: A new metro line is likely to open in our city next year.

items.prompt: Describe something that is due soon (a result, a delivery, a baby).
items.sample: My exam results are due on Monday.

items.prompt: What have you yet to do, although you want to?
items.sample: I have yet to visit Japan.

items.prompt: Write a headline about a company or country using set to / poised to.
items.sample: Tech giant set to launch new phone in March.

items.prompt: What is a company or athlete you follow likely to do soon?
items.sample: The club is likely to sign a new goalkeeper this summer.
